BUILD CALC PRO — CONTRACTOR ESTIMATOR & INVOICE SUITE
============================================================

Thank you for your purchase! Your unique License Key has been
generated by Gumroad and is visible on your receipt and email.

HOW TO USE YOUR PRO SUITE:

1. ONLINE WEB APP (Use on Phone, Tablet, or PC):
   Go to: https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/
   Click 'Unlock Pro' in the top right corner.
   Paste your License Key and click 'Activate'.
   All watermarks will disappear, and custom logo/company info unlocks!

2. 100% OFFLINE EDITION (No Internet / Job Site Truck Use):
   Double-click 'BuildCalc_Pro_Offline_Edition.html' to open it in
   Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox without any internet connection.

3. CHROME / EDGE BROWSER SIDEBAR EXTENSION:
   - Extract 'buildcalc-pro-extension-mv3.zip'
   - In Chrome or Edge, go to chrome://extensions
   - Turn on 'Developer mode' (top right toggle)
   - Click 'Load unpacked' and select the unzipped folder
   - Open the Side Panel while browsing Home Depot or Lowe's to estimate
     materials and build quotes right next to supplier prices!
